senses.gloss: m. (preced.) chiding off, stirring on, cry.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 112b:8">Pes. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>ני׳ דתורא</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="N00254"><he>נהום</he></cite>, corrected into <cite ref="N00428"><he>נזהא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the cry with which to chase an ox away (or goad him on); <he>נ׳ דאריה</he> the lion-hunter’s cry; <he>נ׳ דארבא</he> the sailor’s cry, v. <cite ref="E00362"><he>הַיָיא</he></cite>.
